safe_label: Captured gross Eris-associated product-fee receipts, valued at historical receipt-time reference prices. This is a partial observation set, not all-time Eris legal-entity revenue or Philipp personal retained income.
boundary: Count original product fee transfers at the first captured protocol-fee receipt (including product-to-collector accrual), plus the separately identified original gas fee-share payout stream if requested. Exclude later collector distributions, Creda reserve withdrawals, grants, purchase principal, swaps, internal distributions, forwarded balances and investment rewards. Revenue from associated/self-funded positions is not assumed to be independent customer revenue.
limits: The known captured-period span is 30 May 2022 through 11 October 2026; coverage is incomplete and differs by product, account, chain and time.
576 product-fee receipts in this selected boundary remain unpriced. Their token quantities are not zero; they simply contribute no USD value to this priced subtotal.

Historical quotes are saved market references, generally the preceding completed hourly prices and observed USD conversion; some token valuations use documented redemption references. They are not actual realized dollar proceeds or transaction execution prices.
No operating costs, gas costs, partner revenue rights, taxes, rebates or other deductions have been reconciled into net profit. Some fee-share comes from associated operators’ own calls.

Excluding all collector payouts and reserve withdrawals intentionally avoids an unresolved cross-stage double count; it may also omit economically distinct revenue that has not been matched to its upstream accrual.
The frozen source-fee set includes collector accruals and chains whose ultimate human/legal beneficiary is unresolved. Do not call the combined number personally received by Philipp.
No company cash-flow totals, grants, Neutron token-conversion proceeds, OTC purchased assets or internal payouts are added. No new network queries or changes to canonical records were made.
